snippet.title: Deep Dish Dungeon - Out Now Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Behold Studios and Raw Fury's dungeon crawler rewards curiosity: explore solo or with up to two friends, gather resources, and cook meals back at camp that permanently boost your stats. Solve puzzles, map the depths in your head, and find out what lurks in the shadows.
